prompts.coffee-dose: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: source raster artwork for a custom monochrome Android brewing icon that will be algorithmically converted into low-node filled cubic Bezier vectors. Create one isolated glyph ONLY. Style: polished, hand-crafted geometric silhouette with thoughtfully shaped flowing curves, consistent optical weight, generous negative spaces, restrained character. Pure solid black foreground with genuinely transparent background. Flat 2D, entirely monocolor; only edge antialiasing may vary opacity. No grayscale fills, no shading, gradients, texture, outlines around a filled icon, highlights, reflections, shadows, background, lettering, labels, digits, logo, frame, border, or other objects. Icon alone centered in a square canvas with about 16% safe empty margin. Readable at 24–48 px. Deliberately few large geometric features with clean continuous curves and clear corners; avoid microscopic detail, thin slits, irregular wobbles or disconnected dust. All negative spaces truly transparent. Subject: two substantial plump coffee beans, arranged diagonally as a balanced pair. One bean slightly higher-left, the other lower-right, with a clear generous gap between them. Each bean has an organic oval silhouette with rounded ends and a single gracefully curved S-shaped negative-space seam through its center, broad enough to remain clear at small UI size. The seam should read as a natural coffee-bean division without splintery details. Both beans in the same single black ink, no leaves, spoon, scales, plate or bag.
